description: Promote a prioritized opportunity into a Program + Initiative (starts delivery/Genesis). Requires a codebaseId or githubRepo. Requires `write` scope.

codebaseId.description: Linked codebase ID for the new initiative.

githubBranch.description: Default branch for the new initiative (defaults to main).

githubRepo.description: GitHub repo in owner/name format for the new initiative.

id.description: ID of the opportunity to promote.

programId.description: Existing program to add the new initiative to. If omitted, a new program is created from the opportunity title.

name: anyforge_promote_opportunity
title: Promote opportunity
